blocks.text: LEGAZPI CITY – The National Meat Inspection Service (NMIS) in Bicol assured the public on Thursday that meat supply will be sufficient for the upcoming holiday season, despite concerns that the very strong El Niño is affecting livestock production. During a media forum marking the 33rd Meat Safety Consciousness Week and the 54th NMIS Founding Anniversary, Dr. Alex Templonuevo, regional technical director of the NMIS Bicol, said the agency monitors the number of animals slaughtered in Bicol through daily and monthly reports submitted to the Department of Agriculture’s central office.
